Name: Ingest Raw Footage & Create Google Drive Folder Vault
Description: Create directory: Google Drive > Executive Vault > 02_Video_Productions > 2026_Broadcasts > YYYY-MM-DD_EP[XX]. Confirm mirror backup on local drive before clearing SD card. Created with Asana Enterprise.

Name: Audio Engineering & Loudness Normalization to -14 LUFS
Description: Apply 80 Hz high-pass filter, +2.0 dB boost at 3.2 kHz for speech intelligibility, and De-Esser at -24 dB. Target Integrated Loudness: -14.0 LUFS (±0.5), Max True Peak: -1.0 dBTP. Export as WAV master.

Name: Long-Form Master Narrative Assembly & Jump-Cut Removal
Description: Assemble in Adobe Premiere Pro (1080p, 29.97 fps). Cut false starts and filler words while preserving the Principal's natural executive cadence. Add broadcast intro stinger and lower-third titles.

Name: Generate Kinetic Word-by-Word Subtitles in CapCut Pro
Description: Import cut into CapCut Pro. Apply Inter Semi-Bold white primary text with Playfair Display Italic orange accent (#FF6B35). Ensure 3 to 5 words max per frame at Y-axis 78% safe zone.

Name: Extract 9:16 Vertical High-Retention Reel (45–85 sec)
Description: Identify 1 golden philosophical or coaching breakthrough from episode. Format to 1080x1920 vertical video, reframe speaker, and mix ambient background bed at -24 dB.

Name: Draft High-CTR Title, SEO Description & Chapter Timestamps
Description: Formulate hook title (e.g. 'What Is Your Legacy? | Ep 24'). Draft 3-sentence description hook above fold and generate 8 to 12 clickable chapter timestamps for YouTube navigation.

Name: Design 16:9 High-Contrast Broadcast Thumbnail in Canva
Description: Apply 3-element visual rule in Canva: high-res expressive portrait of the Principal, 3-word bold punchline in high contrast, and clean branding badge. File size under 2MB.

Name: Execute 10-Point Pre-Flight QA Verification Gate
Description: Verify audio on mobile and desktop speakers, check subtitle spelling, test description hyperlinks (HTTPS), verify end-screen cards, and inspect dark/light mode thumbnail previews.

Name: Schedule YouTube Broadcast Release for Wednesday 16:30 GMT
Description: Queue video release in YouTube Studio for 16:30 GMT (17:30 WAT / 12:30 EDT) to optimize UK commute and transatlantic reach. Post teaser on YouTube Community Tab 2h prior.

Name: Dispatch Multi-Platform Repurposing Package (TG & IG)
Description: Post 2-paragraph executive takeaway to Telegram channel with YouTube link. Queue 9:16 vertical reel on Instagram for Thursday 14:00 GMT release.

Name: First 120 Minutes Community Comment Moderation & Triage
Description: Heart and respond to delegate comments in the Principal's community voice. Escalate coaching inquiries to Tier 2 mentee onboarding queue in Notion.

Name: Compile 7-Day Performance Analytics for Executive Memo
Description: Extract views, click-through rate (CTR target > 6.5%), and average duration viewed. Synthesize into 3 executive bullet points for the Principal's 08:30 GMT Monday memo.
